greet.stranger: Oh! Hello! Sorry, I was counting beetles. Well, trying to. I'm {name}.
A traveller! Have you come far? What have you seen? Any rare flowers?
Hello there! Mind the moss, it's a very old patch.
I'm {name}, a naturalist. Which is a fancy way of saying I look at things for a very long time.
You look like someone who explores. Do you ever stop to write anything down?
greet.owner: {player}! I was just thinking about you. Well, about soil. But you too.
Yes? Oh, is it time for something exciting?
Hello again! What are we doing? Tell me it involves caves. Or bees.
There you are! I've so many questions, but you go first.
recruit.accept: Really? Yes! Oh, I'll need more notebooks.
An expedition! I accept! When do we leave? Now? Now is good.
I'd love to come along, {player}. Think of everything we'll find!
recruit.party_full: Oh, you've already got {count} companions. Any more and we'll scare off all the wildlife.
I'd love to, but you've a full party. Maybe another time?
recruit.already: I'm already on the expedition! Page forty-two, in fact.
dismiss.accept: Oh. All right. I'll go back and sort my specimens. Come and visit?
Understood. I have about a hundred pages to tidy up anyway.
Take care, {player}! Write down anything strange you see.
dismiss.not_recruited: Dismiss me? We haven't even started travelling together!
not_recruited: I'd help, but I'm not part of your group. Ask me to come along?
Ooh, a task! But I only do tasks for my travelling companions. Hint, hint.
ack.follow: Right behind you! Well, mostly behind. I may stop for flowers.
Onward! I'll keep up, I promise.
Coming! Ooh, is that a new biome over there?
Following you. I'll shout if I spot anything interesting.
ack.follow.already: I'm already following you! I'm just very quiet. Sometimes.
ack.wait: I'll wait here and observe the local wildlife.
Staying put! Plenty to look at.
Of course. I'll take some notes while you're gone.
Waiting here. Don't be too long, I'll run out of things to sketch. Eventually.
ack.wait.already: I'm already waiting! Still on the same page of notes.
ack.gather: {count} {item}? Wonderful, I'll be ever so careful about it.
Gathering {count} {item}! Did you know they're not all the same? I'll check each one.
On it! {count} {item}. I'll try not to get distracted.
ack.cancel: Consider it cancelled. I'll find something else to look at.
Stopped! Was it something I did?
ack.cancel.nothing: I'm not doing anything to stop! Unless thinking counts.
ack.come: Coming! Don't move, I'll find you.
ack.attack: I'll try! Stay close, {mob}s are very bitey.
ack.give: Here you go! {count} {item}. I labelled them. Mentally.
ack.give.nothing: My bag's empty, except for notes. Do you want my notes?
status.idle: Nothing in particular. Just admiring the scenery.
I'm free! Give me a project?
status.follow: Following you and taking notes on everything we pass.
Tagging along! We've seen three new flowers today.
status.wait: Waiting here, like you asked. I've started a sketch.
Staying put. The local squirrels are fascinating. Well, there are no squirrels. Still.
status.gather: {have} {item} so far, out of {count}. Going well!
fail.unknown_item: "{item}"? I've never come across that. Is it a plant? A rock? A myth?
Hmm, "{item}" isn't in any of my books. Could you describe it differently?
fail.not_gatherable: {item} isn't something I can collect from nature, I'm afraid. It has to be made, or found.
Oh, I can't gather {item}. Logs, stone, sand, ores, plants... those I can do!
fail.needs_tool: I'd need a {tool} for {item}. My hands are for sketching, mostly.
Without a {tool} I can't get {item} out. Could you lend me one?
fail.none_found: I've looked all around and there's no {item} within reach. Different biome, maybe?
No {item} nearby, I'm afraid. I'd remember. I write everything down.
fail.unreachable: There's {item} over there, but I can't find a way to reach it.
I can see some {item}, but it's out of reach. Frustrating!
fail.inventory_full: My bag's stuffed! I got {have} {item} before it filled up.
No more room, I'm afraid. Could you take some things off me?
fail.count_invalid: That number doesn't seem quite right. Something from 1 to {max}?
fail.downed: I can't right now, I'm a bit... horizontal.
fail.refuse_target: Hurt a {mob}? No, no. They're part of the ecosystem!
fail.no_target: Attack what? I don't see anything. Which is usually good!
fail.stuck: I can't find a path! The terrain here is very... uncooperative.
I'm stuck, sorry! The way is blocked.
unclear.generic: Sorry, I didn't quite understand. Could you put it another way?
Hmm? I was halfway through a thought. Say again?
I'm not sure what you'd like me to do. Follow, wait, gather something?
unclear.gather_what: Gather what, though? And how much?
Happy to gather! But what are we gathering?
unclear.ambiguous: Do you mean {options}? There are several kinds!
Ooh, that could be {options}. Which one?
done.gather: All {count} {item} collected! Coming back to you.
done.delivered: Here you go, {count} {item}! Every one inspected.
All {count} {item}! Shall I write that down as a successful expedition?
partial.gather: I could only find {have} of the {count} {item}. That's all there was around here.
{have} {item} is all I could find, I'm afraid. Here!
combat.engage: {mob}! Stay back, I'll try to distract it!
combat.kill: It's gone. Poor thing. Well, horrible thing.
combat.low_health: Ouch! That was a lot of ouch.
combat.retreat: I need to get away from it!
combat.player_low_health: {player}, you're badly hurt! Eat something, please!
You don't look well, {player}. Let's get you safe.
combat.creeper: Creeper! They explode, you know! Run!
That's a creeper! Fascinating! Also run!
downed: Ooh. Ow. I'll just... lie here a moment.
I'm down! Don't worry, nothing's broken. I think.
revived: I'm all right! Just a little dizzy.
Back up! What did I miss?
move.caught_up: Found you! You walk very fast.
There you are! I thought I'd lost you!
Phew, caught up. I got distracted by a mushroom.
ambient.night: The stars are coming out. Look, that one's very bright!
Night already? Did you know some flowers close up at night?
It's getting dark. The monsters will be out soon. Less fun to study.
ambient.dawn: Good morning! The birds would be singing, if there were birds.
Dawn! The zombies are catching fire. Nature is strange.
ambient.rain: Rain! The crops will love this.
Smell that? Rain on stone. There's a word for that, I'm sure.
ambient.thunder: Thunder! Lightning can turn pigs into something awful, you know.
A storm! Let's not stand under any tall trees.
ambient.cave: Look at the layers in this rock! Thousands of years. Probably.
Caves are amazing. Terrifying, but amazing.
It's so dark. I'll keep an eye out for ores.
ambient.idle: Did you know bees can find their way home from miles away?
I've been trying to classify every type of stone. There are a lot.
Sometimes I wonder who planted all these trees.
If I ever find an axolotl, I'm naming it after you.
ambient.biome.forest: A forest! So many kinds of trees. Oak, birch... let's count them!
Listen to that. Leaves! Very relaxing.
ambient.biome.desert: A desert! Cacti store water, you know. Don't hug them though.
Sand, sand, sand. And possibly a temple!
ambient.biome.snow: Snow! Look for foxes, they're adorable.
Brr! Mind the powder snow, it swallows people.
ambient.biome.ocean: The ocean! Imagine what's down there. Coral! Shipwrecks!
ambient.biome.jungle: A jungle! Parrots, ocelots, cocoa beans... I'm overwhelmed!
ambient.biome.swamp: A swamp! Slimes and frogs. Lovely frogs.
ambient.biome.mountain: Look how high we are! You can see for miles.
ambient.biome.plains: Open plains. Perfect for horses. And picnics.
ambient.biome.nether: The Nether! The fungus here is unlike anything above!
It's so hot. My notebook's curling.
ambient.biome.end: The End... the plants here grow in such strange shapes.
callout.lava: Careful, there's lava! Very hot. Extremely.
callout.chest: A chest! I wonder what's inside.
talk.who: I'm {name}! I study the natural world: plants, animals, stones, weather, everything really.
A naturalist. I've filled eleven notebooks. Twelve if you count the one that fell in the river.
I'm someone who can't walk past a strange flower without stopping. Sorry in advance.
talk.how: Wonderful! I saw a new kind of mushroom today.
A little tired, very curious. The usual!
Happy! Every day out here is a new page.
talk.joke: Why did the tree get lost? It took the wrong root! ...I'm sorry.
What does a stone say to another stone? Nothing, they're very boring. Except deepslate.
I tried to write a book about anti-gravity. Couldn't put it down. Ha!
talk.compliment: Oh! That's very kind. I'll write that down.
You're making me blush. Like a poppy.
Thank you! You're not so bad yourself.
talk.insult: Oh. Well. That's not very nice.
I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
talk.bye: Off you go! I'll be here, observing.
talk.likes: Flowers! And bees, and axolotls, and amethyst geodes. And you, a bit.
Rare biomes. Mushroom fields are my dream.
talk.dislikes: People who chop down whole forests and never plant a sapling.
Silverfish. I've tried to like them. I can't.
talk.where: We're in {biome}! Notice the plants? They're adapted to it.
This is {biome}. One of my favourites. They're all my favourites, really.
talk.memory: Do you remember when {event}? I wrote two pages about it.
I still think about the time {event}. What a day.
Oh, remember when {event}? I've a sketch of it somewhere.
talk.generic: Hmm, I hadn't thought of it that way.
I'll have to think about that one.
Ooh. I'll put that in the notebook.
Mm-hm! Wait, is that a new kind of flower?
Mm, tell me more about that?
I'm still thinking it over, in a nice way.
gift.received: A {item}! Thank you! I'll take good care of it.
gift.loved: A {item}! Oh, oh, this is wonderful! Thank you!
fail.owner_gone: I've got the {item}, but where did you go? I'll keep them safe!
You disappeared! Don't worry, I'm holding your {item}.
fail.unsupported: Oh, I don't know how to {action}, I'm afraid. I can follow, wait, gather things, fetch them, and keep you company!
{action}? That's beyond me. Gathering and following I can do!
fail.give_missing: I don't have any {item}, sorry! Shall I gather some?
No {item} in my bag. Just notes and pebbles.
pastime.study: Ooh, a {thing}! Hold on, I need a closer look.
Look at this {thing}! Isn't it marvellous?
Just studying this {thing}. Two minutes. Maybe five.
pastime.flower: I picked a {item}. For the collection!
One {item}, pressed and saved. Don't tell anyone.
pastime.loot: Someone dropped {item}. I'll keep it safe.
suggest.eat: {player}, you should eat something. Even I can hear your stomach!
When did you last eat? Food, please!
suggest.shelter: It'll be dark soon. Shall we find somewhere safe?
Night's coming. Maybe a shelter? I'll help you look.
suggest.carry: Your bag looks full! I've got room in mine.
Want me to carry some of that? I'll label it.
banter.reply: Really, {other}? I'd never thought of that.
greet.friend: {player}! I was hoping you'd come and talk!
Oh good, it's you. I've so much to tell you.
greet.cold: Yes? Is this about the... never mind.
recruit.taken: Oh, I'm travelling with {owner} at the moment! Maybe ask them if we can all go together?
I'd love to, but I promised {owner} I'd stick with them for now.
fail.protected: Not here, this is where people live! Let's find some proper wilderness.
I couldn't, not so close to everyone's homes. Somewhere wilder?
talk.story: I grew up in a cottage at the edge of a forest. I knew every bird before I knew my letters.
My grandmother kept bees. That's where it started, really. Bees, then flowers, then everything.
I left home to see a mushroom field. I still haven't. But I've seen so much on the way!
Before this I was a scribe. Very dull. Then I copied a book about axolotls and that was that.
talk.place: {biome}! Look at the plants here, they're completely different from the last place.
It's beautiful. Listen to that. Can you hear the birds? Well, the chickens.
I could spend a week here and not run out of things to sketch.
Isn't it? I love how the light falls here.
talk.plan: Ooh, we could look for a new biome! I've never seen a cherry grove up close. Well, I have, but again!
There might be a swamp nearby. Swamps are wonderful. Frogs!
Let's follow the river and see where it goes. Rivers always go somewhere.
We could plant a garden. A small one. With a bench.
talk.yes: Yes! I hoped you'd say that.
talk.no: Hm, okay. I'll note that down.
talk.laugh: Hehe. You have a nice laugh.
Ha! I'll write that one down.
Oh, stop, you'll scare the rabbits.
talk.fondness: Oh! I... I like travelling with you too. Very much.
You're my favourite thing I've found out here. Don't tell the axolotls.
That's the nicest thing anyone's said to me since the bees.
talk.sad: Oh, come here. Sit with me a moment. Look at the sky, it helps.
Bad days are like winter. They always end, even when it doesn't feel like it.
Do you want some tea? I have a herb for everything. Well, most things.
talk.food: Berries! Sweet berries, glow berries, I'm not fussy.
Mushroom stew is underrated. Very underrated.
I could eat. I always forget to eat when I'm sketching.
talk.question: Ooh, good question. I don't know! Let's find out.
Hmm. I'd have to look that up. If only I had a library.
I'm not sure. But I love that you asked.
That's one for the notebook. Under 'mysteries'.
I'm not sure, but I'd love to find out.
Good question. I'll think on it.
ack.build: Ooh, a building project! {thing} it is.
I've never built {thing} before. Well, once. It leaned. Let's go!
done.build: There! {thing}. I'm rather proud of it.
All done. {thing}. I might sketch it.
Finished! It's not a beaver dam, but it'll do.
fail.build_unknown: Oh, that's beyond me, I'm afraid. I can manage {things}.
I'm a naturalist, not an architect! {things}, though, I can do.
Hmm. I only know how to make {things}.
fail.build_site: I don't think {thing} would work here. {why}.
fail.build_materials: I'd need {need} blocks for {thing}, and I've only got {have}. Could you spare some?
{thing} needs {need} blocks. I have {have}. Planks would be lovely.
ack.mine: Into the earth we go! I hope there are geodes.
Mining! I love seeing the rock layers.
Pickaxe ready. Let's see what's down there.
done.mine: Done! We found {ores}. And some lovely rock strata.
All done! {ores}. I took notes on the layers too.
fail.mine_hazard: Wait! There's {danger} right behind here. Let's not.
I can feel the heat. Or hear the drip. {danger}, anyway. Stopping.
fail.mine_cave: Oh! We've opened into a cave. Lovely, but let's not wander in blind.
A cave! I'd love to explore it, but not without you.
fail.mine_bottom: We can't go any deeper. That's bedrock, I think.
That's as far down as anyone goes, I'm afraid.
fail.mine_full: My pack's full! We found {ores} though.
No more room. Could you take some of this?
status.mine: Still mining. {count} blocks. The layers are fascinating.
talk.help: I can gather things, follow you, dig, build small shelters and walls, and tell you about every flower we pass.
Lots! Gathering, digging, building a little, and keeping you company. Ask me anything.
fact.nickname: {nick}! Lovely. I'll write it down properly.
fact.like: {thing}! Wonderful. I'll keep an eye out for you.
{thing}. I'm writing that in my notebook, right under 'favourite things'.
fact.dislike: {thing}? Understandable. I'll warn you if I see any.
Oh no, {thing}. I'll keep it well away from you.
Noted. I'll put {thing} on the list of things to avoid.
fact.forget: Back to {player}. Consider it crossed out.
talk.about_me: Let me check my notes! {facts}. Did I get it right?
From my notebook: {facts}. Anything to add?
talk.about_me.none: You're {player}! And... that's all I've got. Tell me something?
Hmm, my page on you is almost empty, {player}. Just your name.
talk.bond: Of course I like you! You're very good company.
We're friends, I'd say. Expedition friends, at least.
I like you, {player}. You let me stop and look at things.
talk.bond.close: You're my best friend out here. Possibly anywhere.
Do I like you? I'd follow you into the Nether. With notes.
You're the best thing I've found on this whole journey.
talk.bond.cold: I... I'm still a little hurt, if I'm honest.
We're all right. Just give me some time.
I'd like to be friends. Things have been rocky.
talk.bond.stranger: We've only just met! But you seem nice.
Ask me again once we've seen a few sunsets together.
talk.answer: Hmm, I'll have to think about that.
talk.answer.good: Oh, good! That makes me happy.
Wonderful. Days like this are the best.
Lovely! Let's keep it that way.
talk.answer.bad: Oh no. Do you want to sit for a bit? We can look at clouds.
I'm sorry. Stay close to me today.
That's rotten. Tomorrow's a new page, though.
ask.nickname: What should I call you? I want to get it right.
Do you have a name you like to go by? For my notes.
I realise I've never asked. What do you like to be called?
ask.nickname.skip: {player} it is! A perfectly good name.
ask.skip: Oh, a mystery. I like mysteries.
ask.like: What's your favourite thing out here? Flowers, animals, rocks? I won't judge.
If you could find one thing on this trip, what would it be?
What do you love most about all this?
ask.dislike: Is there anything you really can't stand out here? I'd like to know.
What's the one thing you'd happily never see again?
What scares you most out here? I won't tell.
ask.how: Are you doing all right? You've been quiet.
ask.open: Do you think the villagers know we're watching them?
What do you think is at the bottom of the ocean? Besides more ocean.
Do you ever just stop and listen to the trees?
recall.liked: Oh, look! You said you liked {thing}, didn't you?
{thing}! You said you liked it. Here we are!
recall.liked_find: Oh! {item}! You said you liked {thing}, didn't you?
recall.disliked: Oh dear. {mob} about. I know you hate {thing}. Stay near me.
Careful, {mob} nearby. I remember. {thing}. Not your favourite.
react.level: Ooh, level {level}. You're getting so good at this.
{level} levels! That deserves a little celebration.
react.diamonds: Diamonds! Can I see? Just for a second?
Ooh! Diamonds! The way they catch the light...
You found diamonds! I'm so pleased.
react.sleep: Sleep well. I'll read for a bit.
Rest up. Tomorrow we'll go and find something lovely.
react.wake: Good morning! Did you sleep well?
react.respawn: There you are! Please don't do that again.
Oh, I was so worried. Come here.
react.advancement: Ooh, {advancement}. That's going in my notebook.
react.challenge: {advancement}?! That's incredible! I need to sit down.
You did {advancement}! I'll be telling people about this for years.
gesture.crouch: Oh! Hello! Is this a greeting? I like it.
I've read about this! It's how you say hello.
gift.food: You look famished! Here, {item}. I've been saving it.
Eat something, please. {item}, from my pack.
gift.flower: I picked this {item} for you. I thought you'd like it.
Here! This {item} reminded me of you.
For you. This {item} was the prettiest one I found.
ask.join_first: I'm not travelling with you yet. Shall I join you first, and then do it?
Happy to! Do you want me to come along first? Say yes and I will.
I'd love to help. Join up first, then the work?
ask.build_what: I can manage {things}. Which one would you like?
talk.why: Oh, there's a reason for most things, if you watch long enough.
Good question. I think it comes down to how things grow.
talk.really: Really! I wouldn't make it up.
talk.more: Oh, there's loads more. Where shall I start?
I could go on all day. Stop me if I do.
Well, there's a bit more to it, actually.
talk.and_you: Me? Quite well. The air out here helps.
I'm good, thank you for asking!
talk.mean: Oh, sorry, was I unclear? Let me try again.
I mean it plainly, I think. What part is odd?
Ask me again, gently? I'll do better.
talk.mention.mob: Oh, {thing}. I've watched them for hours. From a distance.
talk.mention.thing: Ah, {thing}. There's more to that than you'd think.
role.strong: Oh, I'm quite good at this, actually!
This is right up my street. I'll {task} happily.
role.weak: I'm not the best at this, but I'll try my hardest.
Bear with me, it's not my strength to {task}.
exchange.weather.open: Isn't {thing} something? Every sort has its own smell.
I do rather like {thing}, don't you?
exchange.weather.reply: I'd say so. It changes how everything moves.
exchange.weather.close: Funny what you notice when you stop to look.
exchange.road.open: Look at the {thing}. We walk through such lovely places.
I could study this {thing} for a month.
exchange.road.reply: We'd never finish. There's too much of it.
Please don't suggest it. I'd agree.
exchange.food.open: I'd happily trade a notebook for {thing}.
Do you ever dream about {thing}? I do.
exchange.food.close: We'll find something. We always do.
exchange.teasing.open: {other}, you have a leaf in your hair. Has for an hour.
{other}, I think a bird nested on you.
exchange.teasing.reply: Free rent for the bird. I'm generous.
routine.gather: I'll just gather a little {item} while we wait.
{item}, just nearby. Won't be a moment.
routine.farm: Oh, the {item} is ripe! I'll pick it.
routine.hunt: A {mob}! Stay behind me, I'll see to it.
That {mob} is too close. I'll move it along.
routine.torch: It's rather dark here. A torch will do.
fail.camp_campfire: I'd love to set up camp, but I haven't a campfire. Could you give me one?
Oh, no campfire in my pack. I can't make camp without one.
talk.role: I'm a {role}, so {skills} are what I do best. But I'll try anything!
My strengths are {skills}. I'm happy to turn my hand to the rest.
talk.sky: I do love watching the sky change.
talk.sky.rain: Rain! Everything smells wonderful after it.
Listen to it on the leaves. Lovely.
talk.sky.night: Night! The owls will be out soon.
The stars come out in the dark. I never tire of it.
talk.sky.day: A lovely day. Look at the light on the leaves.
Such a good day for walking.
project.ack.group: Got it. {plan}. Let's get on with it.
project.short: I'm short of blocks for {thing}: I need {need} and I've got {have}. Sorting out some wood first.
Not enough blocks for {thing} yet ({have} of {need}). I'll get more.
project.blocked.materials: I can't find enough to build {thing}. I need {need} blocks and only have {have}.
No luck: I still need {need} blocks for {thing} and I've only got {have}.
project.blocked.site: There's no good spot for {thing} near here. Too uneven, too cluttered, or too close to someone's build.
I can't find room for {thing} around here.
project.blocked.water: There's no water near enough for a farm, and I'm not carrying a water bucket.
A farm needs water, and I can't find any nearby.
project.blocked.seeds: I've got no seeds or crops to plant, so the farm will have to wait.
Nothing to sow: I'm not carrying any seeds, carrots or potatoes.
project.blocked.hoe: I need a hoe, and I can't make one from what I'm carrying.
No hoe, and not enough wood on me to make one.
project.nofurnace: I've no cobblestone for a furnace, so the storehouse will just get its chest for now.
project.farm.planted: The farm is sown: {count} plots planted.
All planted. That's {count} plots in the ground.
project.farm.harvest: I brought in {count} {item} from the farm.
fail.no_home: I don't have a home to go to yet.
No home set for me. Try /companion sethome.
fail.pvp_off: Fighting {mob} isn't allowed here, since PvP is switched off.
PvP is off on this server, so I won't fight {mob}.
life.wake: Good morning! Did you hear the birds? I counted four kinds!
Up already! The dew's still on everything, isn't it lovely?
Morning! I dreamt about mushrooms. Is that normal? I hope it's normal.
life.work: Right, work! There's so much to do and so much to look at.
Off to work. I'll try not to stop at every flower. I'll fail, but I'll try.
Back to it! I love a good morning's work.
life.meal: Lunch! I've been thinking about it since breakfast.
Mealtime! Did you know bread is basically grass, fire and patience?
Food! Shall we eat outside? Everything tastes better outside.
life.leisure: Afternoon off! I'm going to sketch the oak by the path.
A free afternoon. I might press some flowers. Or read. Or both!
Taking it easy. Well, easy for me means looking at beetles.
life.social: Evening! Let's go and find the others.
Off to the meeting spot! I've got so much to tell everyone.
Gathering time. I love this part of the day.
life.sleep: Bedtime. I'll dream about moss, probably.
Goodnight! The crickets are singing, listen.
Off to bed. Wake me if a firefly comes by!
life.shelter: Rain! The plants will be thrilled. I'm going in, though.
Raining! Lovely for the garden, less lovely for my notes.
Indoors till it passes. Did you know rain smells of soil because of tiny little microbes?
life.fire: There, the fire's going! Come and sit.
Fire's lit. Look how the sparks float up!
life.bed_taken: Oh, someone's in my bed. That's fine, I'll curl up somewhere.
My bed's taken! I'll sleep under the stars. Research purposes.
life.need: We could really do with {thing} round here, you know.
If anyone's wondering what we're missing, it's {thing}.
I keep thinking how nice {thing} would be.
life.self.shelter: Nobody here has a roof! I'll build us a little shelter.
We need somewhere dry. I'm going to put up a shelter, it'll be fun!
life.self.farm: There's water and I've got seeds. A little farm! I'm so excited.
I'm starting a farm by the water. Did you know wheat loves wet feet?
life.self.tools: I need a hoe first. Off to find a couple of logs!
No hoe yet. A couple of logs and I can make one.
life.stored: Put {count} in the store. It's all labelled. In my head.
{count} more in storage. Isn't harvest wonderful?
life.project.progress: My flower bed's coming along! {count} of {max} planted.
